MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
MATCH (o)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT o,
  CASE
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, '/') THEN strptime(o.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d')
    ELSE strptime(o.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y')
  END AS birth
WITH o.nationality AS col1,
  MIN(
    2026 - CAST(date_part('year', birth) AS INT64) -
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(date_part('month', birth) AS INT64) > 10
        OR (CAST(date_part('month', birth) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(date_part('day', birth) AS INT64) > 14)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS col2
RETURN col1 AS col1, col2 AS col2

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
MATCH (o)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT o,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(split_part(split_part(o.birth_date, ',', 2), ' ', 2) AS INT64) END AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'January') THEN 1
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'February') THEN 2
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'March') THEN 3
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'April') THEN 4
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'May') THEN 5
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'June') THEN 6
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'July') THEN 7
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'August') THEN 8
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'September') THEN 9
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'October') THEN 10
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'November') THEN 11
    WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, 'December') THEN 12
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(o.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(split_part(split_part(o.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', 1) AS INT64) END AS birth_day
WITH o.nationality AS col1,
  MIN(2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS col2
RETURN col1 AS col1, col2 AS col2
